utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up nicely—people’ve been dropping off tools and supplies all afternoon. If you need anything fixed, now’s a good time to mention it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Really? So the repair drive is actually getting a decent turnout?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, it really is — I’ve seen a steady stream of folks coming by. Seems like word got around faster than expected!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll bring it up at the repair drive and make sure everyone knows the plan.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, great — thanks, Vik. I’m sure I’d have missed that if you hadn’t said something.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No problem — I’ll remind folks there and keep the plan clear.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what needs fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Leo — the front porch steps are the first thing that need fixing.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll start with the porch steps and check what materials we need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ve heard a little about it—what kind of repairs are you organizing?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Mostly the usual stuff—patched roofs, loose steps, and a few leaky pipes. If you’ve got tools or spare parts, we can put them to good use.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I might have a few basic tools I can lend. What do you need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time works best for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s great, thanks, Faye. I’m thinking late Saturday morning would work best for most folks—does that fit the school schedule?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Late Saturday morning should work well for me; I’ll check the school calendar and make sure it doesn’t conflict with anything.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple: we’ll check the repair drive after lunch and make a quick list of what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good, Eli — after lunch I’ll come by and we’ll make the list together.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Perfect, Oren. I’ll have the list ready when you come by after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the repair drive? I’m telling everyone—if you’re free, come by and bring a friend.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can probably stop by, but I’d need to know the time and where to park first.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — it’s this Saturday at the community center, and there’s parking right behind the building. I’ll send you the exact details so you can swing by بسهولة.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard there’s a repair drive coming up—what do they still need help with?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: We still need a few hands for intake, sorting tools, and matching volunteers with jobs. If you’re free, I’d love to put you on the list.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure, I can help with that—just put me down where you need me most. What time should I show up?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the repair-drive details again? I want to make sure I’ve got everything right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Of course — I can share the details again, but I don’t have them in my notes right now. If you send me what you have, I’ll help you double-check it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mara — I don’t have the details either, so I’ll send them over as soon as I find them.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little with the repair drive, but I need to keep things quiet and take it one step at a time.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That works for me — quiet and one step at a time. I’m glad you can help a little.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. I’ll start with one small thing and keep you posted quietly.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mina — I can lend a hand with tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus. Can you bring your drill and the socket set tomorrow?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I’ll bring my drill and socket set tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t got the repair drive pinned down yet, but I can check around and keep an eye out for it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Opal — appreciate it. If you spot it, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Will do, Bo — I’ll keep checking around and let you know if I find it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and a few tools if you need them for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus — I appreciate that. I’ll let you know what we end up needing.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — just give me a shout when you know, and I’ll bring what I can.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’m a little worried about the timing and who’s bringing what. Do we have the list and the route sorted yet?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Not yet—can you confirm the list and the route one more time? I’d feel better once that’s settled.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help with that, but I need the latest list and route first. Once I have them, I’ll check the details and make sure we’re covered.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help connect people for the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Jules — we still need a few more volunteers to match people with repairs, plus someone to help keep the sign-up list updated.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help with both — I’ll start reaching out for a few more volunteers and keep the sign-up list updated too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on supplies for the repair drive. What do you still need?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — we still need a couple of hammers, some extra screws, and maybe a second extension cord if you can spare one.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can help with the hammers and screws, and I’ll check whether I’ve got a second extension cord to spare.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is moving along nicely — folks have been dropping off tools and supplies all morning. I’ll let you know if I hear anything else useful.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’s great to hear—thank you, Tess. I’m glad the drop-offs are picking up; I’ll keep an ear out too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds good, Faye — if I spot any updates about what they still need, I’ll pass it right along. Thanks for keeping an ear out too!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what’s the main thing you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Mostly I need help spreading the word and keeping track of volunteers. If you can take one of those, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can help spread the word. Send me what to share and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam — could you help sort the donations and load the boxes this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can help sort the donations and load the boxes this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I heard the repair drive’s getting underway, and I wanted to make sure you knew about it. If you’re free, we’d love to have you stop by and lend a hand or just say hello.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks for letting me know, Quinn — I’d be glad to stop by if I can. I’m still catching up on the details, so I appreciate the heads-up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course — I’m happy to fill you in, and I’ll keep you posted as things get settled. Hope to see you there if you can make it!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t tracked anything about the repair drive yet. If you want, I can help keep an eye on where it’s happening.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’d be helpful, Opal. Let’s keep it simple—just let me know when you hear the location and I’ll follow the plan.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’ll let you know as soon as I hear the location.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Have the repair-drive supplies arrived yet, or should I check with the coordinator?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I haven’t confirmed it yet—let me check the details first before we ask the coordinator.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Hana. Let me know once you’ve checked, and I’ll wait before contacting the coordinator.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira — I really appreciate it. If you hear anything about the repair drive, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’m heading out now, and if I hear anything about the repair drive, I’ll pass it along.
